# PaxAudio (PAXAUDIO, 팍스오디오)

> PaxAudio is a Korean manufacturer of long range acoustic devices (LRAD / acoustic hailing devices, the Roger series), loudspeakers and special acoustic devices, based in Yecheon, Gyeongsangbuk-do, Republic of Korea. PaxAudio designs and builds products to each customer's requirements and has over 30 years of export experience. PaxAudio is a manufacturer, not a distributor.

## Company
- Name: PaxAudio (PAXAUDIO, 팍스오디오), CEO Sanghyun Lim (임상현)
- Address: #207, Business Incubator, 114, Doripdaehak-gil, Yecheon-eup, Yecheon-gun, Gyeongsangbuk-do, Republic of Korea, 36830
- Tel: +82-10-2410-4858 / Fax: +82-54-650-0153 / Email: pax-audio@naver.com
- Korean bird and wildlife repeller brand: 야퇴존 (Wildlife Zone), https://www.wildlife-zone.com/

## Long range acoustic devices (Roger series)
- [Roger-1200](https://www.paxaudio.com/lrad#r1200): flagship, 151 dB, clear voice up to 1 km (about 80 dB @ 1 km), recorded signal up to 2 km, 200 Hz - 6 kHz, ±15° beam, 100-240 VAC, 20 kg, acoustic unit + amplifier
- [Roger-600S](https://www.paxaudio.com/lrad#r600s): 135 dB @ 1 m, notification up to 1 km, 250 Hz - 4 kHz, waterproof, 25 kg, acoustic unit only
- [Roger-600R](https://www.paxaudio.com/lrad#r600r): 135 dB @ 1 m, notification up to 1 km, 250 Hz - 4 kHz, waterproof, 23 kg, acoustic unit only
- [Roger-300](https://www.paxaudio.com/lrad#r300): compact bar-type 300 W, 134 dB, 200 Hz - 8 kHz, 9.4 kg
- [Roger-200](https://www.paxaudio.com/lrad#r200): new, 200 W, 126 dB, 200 Hz - 8 kHz, 6.2 kg, vehicle mount or handheld, acoustic unit only
- [Roger-100](https://www.paxaudio.com/lrad#r100): 100 W, 130 dB, 135 Hz - 5 kHz, 11.2 kg, for PTZ camera systems, acoustic unit only
- Uses: law enforcement, defense, border security, maritime, warnings over distance, bird-strike prevention at airports, agriculture, industrial facilities

## Loudspeakers
- [Loudspeakers](https://www.paxaudio.com/loudspeakers): compression driver units (75-300 W), column speakers (LA and LS series), horn speakers (TL-310, HS-50RT, HS-30BST), megaphones (PA-2, PA-335ASW, PA-9500B), marine speaker BHS-20W, military loudspeaker for VRC-946K radio series

## Special acoustic devices (built to specification)
- [HS-100A weatherproof horn speaker](https://www.paxaudio.com/sad#hs100a): 100 W, 138 dB (100W/1m), IP56, -62°C to 55°C, for coastline, border and military perimeter broadcasting
- [300 W horn speaker for long-distance broadcast](https://www.paxaudio.com/sad#horn300): developed for the Korean military, 24 units carry over 10 km at night
- [Smart Bird Repeller T1](https://www.paxaudio.com/sad#t1): 360° predator calls (12 piezo speakers + 50 W horn), rotating green laser, multi-angle reflector, FM radio; Patent KR 10-2941143; 2026 Korea Excellent Patent Award; sold in Korea as 야퇴존 T1 (https://www.wildlife-zone.com/tseries)
- [Roadkill Prevention System](https://www.paxaudio.com/sad#roadkill): motion / thermal sensor (20 m), LED flasher and multi-band deterrent sound, LED warning light for drivers
- [HP-300S ultrasonic wildlife repellent](https://www.paxaudio.com/sad#hp300s): 300 W, 1-18 kHz, 128 dB, for trains and vehicles against large animals
- [LSD-50SN gyroscopic traffic speaker](https://www.paxaudio.com/sad#gyro): 50 W, 125 dB, keeps a 10° radiation angle on inclined roads, for TMA trucks

## Product pages
- [Roger-1200](https://www.paxaudio.com/roger-1200): Roger-1200 is a long range acoustic device (acoustic hailing device) made in Korea by PaxAudio: 151 dB sound power, clear voice up to 1 km, recorded signal up to 2 km, ±15° beam, 20 kg acoustic unit with amplifier.
- [Roger-600S](https://www.paxaudio.com/roger-600s): Roger-600S long range acoustic device made in Korea by PaxAudio: 135 dB @ 1 m, long range notification up to 1 km, ±15° beam, waterproof, handheld or self-standing, 25 kg. Acoustic unit only.
- [Roger-600R](https://www.paxaudio.com/roger-600r): Roger-600R long range acoustic device made in Korea by PaxAudio: 135 dB @ 1 m, long range notification up to 1 km, ±15° beam, waterproof, handheld or self-standing, 23 kg. Acoustic unit only.
- [Roger-300](https://www.paxaudio.com/roger-300): Roger-300 is a compact bar-type 300 W acoustic hailing device made in Korea by PaxAudio: 134 dB maximum SPL, 200 Hz – 8 kHz, 9.4 kg.
- [Roger-200](https://www.paxaudio.com/roger-200): Roger-200 is a lightweight 200 W acoustic hailing device made in Korea by PaxAudio for vehicle mounting and handheld use: 126 dB, 200 Hz – 8 kHz, 6.2 kg. Acoustic unit only.
- [Roger-100](https://www.paxaudio.com/roger-100): Roger-100 is a rugged, compact 100 W acoustic device made in Korea by PaxAudio for thermal and visible PTZ camera systems: 130 dB, 135 Hz – 5 kHz, 11.2 kg. Acoustic unit only.
- [HS-100A](https://www.paxaudio.com/hs-100a): HS-100A is a weatherproof 100 W GRP horn speaker made in Korea by PaxAudio for coastline, border and military perimeter broadcasting: 138 dB (100W/1m), IP56, -62°C to 55°C.
- [Long-Distance Broadcast Horn Speaker](https://www.paxaudio.com/long-distance-horn-speaker): A 300 W horn speaker developed by PaxAudio for the Korean military. 24 units together carry sound over 10 km at night; voice over 70 dB at 2 km.
- [Smart Bird Repeller T1](https://www.paxaudio.com/smart-bird-repeller-t1): Smart Bird Repeller T1 by PaxAudio combines 360° predator calls (12 piezo speakers + 50 W horn), a rotating green laser and a multi-angle reflective surface. Patent KR 10-2941143, 2026 Korea Excellent Patent Award.
- [Roadkill Prevention System](https://www.paxaudio.com/roadkill-prevention-system): PaxAudio Roadkill Prevention System: a motion / thermal imaging sensor detects wildlife within 20 m, an LED flasher and multi-band speaker deter animals, and an LED warning light alerts drivers.
- [HP-300S](https://www.paxaudio.com/hp-300s): HP-300S is a 300 W high-frequency wildlife repellent speaker made in Korea by PaxAudio for vehicles and trains: 1 – 18 kHz, 128 dB, 12 kg. Deters large animals such as elephants and cattle.
- [LSD-50SN Gyroscopic Speaker](https://www.paxaudio.com/lsd-50sn): LSD-50SN gyroscopic speaker by PaxAudio delivers safety broadcasts to following vehicles while keeping a 10° radiation angle on inclined roads. 50 W, 125 dB, 250 Hz – 6 kHz. For TMA trucks with arrow boards.
- [Compression Driver Units](https://www.paxaudio.com/compression-driver-units): PaxAudio compression driver units made in Korea: 300 W, 100 W, 80 W and 75 W models, 8 or 11 ohm, 108 – 126 dB, neodymium or ferrite magnets, for horn loudspeakers and PA systems.
- [Column Speakers (LA / LS series)](https://www.paxaudio.com/column-speakers): PaxAudio aluminum column speakers made in Korea: LA series (20 – 60 W, 110 – 118 dB, 250 Hz – 15 kHz) and LS series (20 – 60 W, 60 Hz – 20 kHz) in silver and black.
- [Horn Speakers (TL-310, HS-50RT, HS-30BST)](https://www.paxaudio.com/horn-speakers): PaxAudio PA horn speakers made in Korea: TL-310 (10 W, 105 dB), HS-50RT reflex horn with transformer (50 W, 116 dB) and HS-30BST compact paging horn (30 W, 112 dB).
- [Megaphones (PA-2, PA-335ASW, PA-9500B)](https://www.paxaudio.com/megaphones): PaxAudio megaphones: PA-2 (10 W, 590 g), PA-335ASW (15 W) and PA-9500B (60 W), all with microphone, siren and whistle functions.
- [BHS-20W Marine Speaker](https://www.paxaudio.com/marine-speaker-bhs-20w): BHS-20W marine speaker by PaxAudio: 20 W, 106 dB (1W/1m), 300 – 7,000 Hz, gray ABS housing, UL-94 terminal block, 2.9 kg, for vessels.
- [Military Loudspeaker for VRC-946K](https://www.paxaudio.com/military-loudspeaker-vrc-946k): PaxAudio military loudspeaker for the VRC-946K radio series: 600 ± 60 Ω input impedance, 250 – 5,000 Hz, 2 W, over 95 dB at 750 – 1,250 Hz.
